visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a dark plate holding a large, airy mound of extremely thin, translucent white sugar strands that resemble silk or a bird's nest. Large white Traditional Chinese text overlays the top and bottom of the frame against a teal background. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a soft white marshmallow and rubbing it firmly in a circular motion against the surface of a black, speckled non-stick frying pan, leaving behind a faint web of melted sugar. (3) A wooden chopstick is dipped into the center of the sugar residue on the pan and pulled upwards, drawing out several thick, elastic white strands. The background is a studio kitchen with light-colored walls. (4) A male chef dressed in a white culinary coat with a red logo on the chest stands in the center of the kitchen studio. He holds a chopstick high, pulling a massive web of fine, hair-like sugar threads from the pan as he speaks with an animated expression. (5) Multiple close-up and medium shots alternate between the chef's face and the intricate process of pulling the sugar threads wide using both hands and chopsticks, showcasing the delicate, mesh-like texture of the marshmallow. (6) The chef holds a finished plate of the sugar 'silk' nest, gesturing toward it with an open palm. He smiles and talks directly into the camera, looking proud of the result.

(2) The background music maintains a consistent, driving rhythm as the speaker details technical steps about heat and oil. The acoustic environment is very clean, indicating a studio recording. (3) Subtle rubbing sounds are heard as the marshmallow hits the pan, blending with the speaker's rhythmic delivery. (4) As the marshmallow threads are pulled, the main speaker's pitch rises dramatically. Off-screen staff or crew members are heard laughing and making 'wow' sounds of amazement. (5) The speaker maintains a professional yet comedic tone, concluding with a boastful phrase. The BGM continues steadily underneath the entire vocal track without interruption.
